description: Nombre d'antennes - réseaux mobiles - Orléans Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Orléans Métropole. Nombre d'antennes de tout réseau mobile confondu (Orange, SFR, Bouygues et Free) par commune sur les 22 communes d'Orléans métropole calculé à partir des données des sites mobiles de monreseaumobile (ARCEP). Mise à jour mensuelle. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The publisher named on the listing is Orléans Métropole. Its keywords include inclusion-numerique, internet, reseau-mobile, telecommunication, fragilite-numerique. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
